notes.title: Online mode to play against friends and new bgm added
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/c1fce3c331295bbd8855a673786846b5a6a1d8b9.png[/img]
[h1]Introducing the new PvP battle feature "Friend Match," allowing casual matches with friends in a vibrant and strategic digital card game.[/h1]


[previewyoutube=6v4pVI_YnuQ;full][/previewyoutube]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/9ae69dafce7bd3717dda4662d35eff474fe408d1.png[/img]

[h2][olist]
[*]🌞PVP
[*]🌞Enhanced effects
[*]🌞Kumi Tanioka, composer of Final Fantasy XI
[/olist][/h2]
[url=steam://run/2457730][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/bc747c6fabbb7fe0bfb71fe62ea3dc21c7aa8669.png[/img][/url]

[b][h2]1.🌞PVP[/h2][/b] 
[h3]Now you can battle your friends using Friend Codes, and enjoy simple communication with in-game stamps.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/14b95544c00615c3c070bc30a87d132da0da8021.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/609564ab36c24f436499a60f6ae40ff6004444b5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/7541f69125a6e750c1bcea1a2771e7dfaaa89b5f.png[/img]

[b][h2]2.🌞Enhanced effects[/h2][/b]
 [h3]Enhanced effects with a new camera system for dynamic battle visuals.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/373cc097797efe5f6cadcf74114437c6ed1024d5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/7541f69125a6e750c1bcea1a2771e7dfaaa89b5f.png[/img]

[b][h2]3.🌞Kumi Tanioka, composer of Final Fantasy XI[/h2][/b]
[h3]Additionally, a new track by Kumi Tanioka, composer of Final Fantasy XI, has been added, elevating the immersive battle experience. Stay tuned for more exciting updates![/h3]

One of the joys of "Freaks Peak" is its unique soundtrack, featuring music composed by Kumi Tanioka. This is her first attempt at composing for a card game, and her addictive melodies truly shine in this title!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/dcec92a0ef99ba7e126f79ed70faabacf4bfbf6c.png[/img]
[b][h2]🌞Game Overview[/h2][/b]
"Free.ks Peak" is a new kind of digital TCG that combines attributes and strategies for limitless possibilities. Utilize 9 adorable yet greedy characters and 168 cards to build your ultimate deck and defeat your opponents to reach the top!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/c7fc8f978b723ba11deb4784f4c4d51fba1acd29.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/218290695e5ab434580de7ca4b8007af64b1c8c2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/57c0ece285ebf9575e00de5188669fdd51775ca0.jpg[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/dcec92a0ef99ba7e126f79ed70faabacf4bfbf6c.png[/img]
[b][h2]🌞Features:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Diverse attribute and type combinations
Combine four attributes (Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth) with two types (Light and Darkness) for endless strategic depth!

[*] Unique cards for all 9 characters
Each character has 2 exclusive cards, making a total of 18 unique cards for truly personalized deck-building.

[*] Beginner-friendly intuitive controls
Simple mechanics combined with deep strategy make the game enjoyable for both beginners and seasoned players.

[*] Stunning 3D graphics
Both characters and cards are beautifully rendered in 3D, delivering an immersive battle experience.

[*] Four battle modes available
Enjoy various modes, including the newly updated PvP feature, for endless fun.

[*] Over 70 story episodes
Follow the engaging story of 9 "Freaks" with unique desires through more than 70 episodes presented in a scrollable comic style.
[/list]

[url=steam://run/2457730][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837769/bc747c6fabbb7fe0bfb71fe62ea3dc21c7aa8669.png[/img][/url]
